description:
Hey Innovators! I'm Dilson Joy Pinto from Karnataka, leading a team for the NASA Space Apps Challenge (Universal Event). I specialize in computer architecture, C, Python, and analytics.

We are building Healthcare Monitoring Software for Astronauts. To beat deep-space communication delays, we're creating an offline AI "digital doctor" to track vitals and predict health risks.

Looking for passionate minds in software dev, AI/ML, UI/UX, or space tech. Let's win this hackathon!
